market: Europe Vinyl Acetate Ethylene (VAE) Emulsion Adhesives Market
market_definition: The vinyl acetate ethylene emulsion adhesives market comprises water-based adhesives made from VAE copolymer dispersions that offer flexibility and strong adhesion to low-energy surfaces. It measures sales of finished adhesives for packaging, nonwovens and building products. BY ETHYLENE CONTENT: Low Ethylene, Medium Ethylene, High Ethylene. BY STABILISER SYSTEM: PVOH-Stabilised, Surfactant-Stabilised. BY END-USE INDUSTRY: Packaging & Paper Converting, Nonwovens & Hygiene, Building & Construction, Textiles, Other End-Use Industries. BY REGION: North America, Latin America, Europe, Asia Pacific (APAC), Middle East, Africa. EXCLUDED from the market: PVAc emulsion adhesives; acrylic emulsion adhesives; VAE dispersions sold for paints, redispersible powders or cement additives. COMPANY TYPE IN THIS LIST - DISTRIBUTOR: a distributor, stockist or specialty reseller that buys these products from their makers and sells them to industrial, construction or trade customers. EXCLUDED companies: product and raw-material makers and their own sales subsidiaries; companies selling only the excluded products; service-only firms. GEOGRAPHY OF THIS LIST: EUROPE - companies headquartered in a European country (EU, United Kingdom, EFTA, Western Balkans, Ukraine, Moldova, Russia).
who_is_included: DISTRIBUTOR DEFINITION (physical goods market): a company whose PRIMARY business is buying in volume from manufacturers and reselling/distributing onward - wholesale, authorized, value-added or stocking distributor. EXCLUDED: channel partners, resellers, VARs, dealers, agents and brokers that do not stock or wholesale; manufacturers and OEMs (including a manufacturer's own sales subsidiary); system integrators; and pure service providers or consultancies. Continent / Geography = countries with a physical site (HQ, office, warehouse, plant). Operational Presence = every country the company does business in, which is WIDER.
